_doc: item Profile 8 80x40 light (0.0.026.34): 80 x 40 mm, Line 8, the light shape, natural anodised. Dimensions and section figures are item's product data sheet; the groove is item's table of groove dimensions. It is described lying flat, so inertia_x is the smaller second moment (item's x-axis). The drawn outline leaves out the hollow behind each lip of the light groove, the rounded mouths and the rounds in the hollows, so it comes out 5 to 8% heavier than item's figures and about 10% stiffer in bending: a beam should use the sheet's figures.
